America's #1 desi live comedy dating show is now in Los Angeles!

About this Event

Garam Masala Dating LA
Sunday, December 27th, 2026
Doors 7:15PM // Show 7:30PM
$20 Early Bird // GA $30 // $35 Day of // $40 Front Row // $20 Group Rate (must be 4-10 people)
This performance will include an intermission.
**Lineup subject to change**
Late Arrivals will be turned away 20 minutes after scheduled event start.
No Refunds or Exchanges. Tickets are Not Eligible for Resale and Resold Tickets Will Not Be Valid for Entry.
For the protection of our audiences we reserve the right to refuse service.

Two strangers.
One stage.
A packed room full of people who came to watch it all go down.

Garam Masala Dating is the biggest live comedy dating show in the country. Every show, a real couple goes on a blind date in front of a live audience while hosts Surbhi and Wyatt Feegrado play wingman, roast them and try to keep things from going completely off the rails.
And if you're in the audience and single and like what you see, you can actually steal one of the daters for yourself. Right there. On stage. In front of everyone.
After the show, the night continues with an afterparty so you can shoot your shot too.

What to expect:
-A full live blind date with all the awkward, hilarious, romantic moments you'd normally only hear about secondhand.
-The chance to jump on stage and steal a single for yourself.
-An afterparty where the audience can meet each other and exchange numbers
90 to 120 minutes of comedy, chaos and genuine connection.
-A packed room who are all there because they love a good time.
-You don't need to be single. You don't need to be South Asian. You just need to show up ready to laugh.
-4 seasons. 40+ shows. 50 million views on our clips. Over 200,000 followers across platforms. This is the show everyone keeps telling you about.
